from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyQuarterlyFinancial(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's quarterly report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by the report, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    comprehensive_income_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label in the document, e.g., 综合收益总额")
    comprehensive_income_value: float | None = Field(description="The total comprehensive income amount as a signed number; losses are negative")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the data point")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_quarterly_financials: list[CompanyQuarterlyFinancial]
